# Magic Circle Synthesis (Project 2) Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Replace the two-input synthesis altar and the fixed skill tree with a magic circle drawn on parchment (core, ring 1 pentagram, ring 2, one rune per ring) whose spells are generated by shared rules, rolled by the server, and remembered on a five-element star map.

**Architecture:** A pure engine layer (`src/engine/circle.ts` rules + `src/engine/circle-spell.ts` generator) turns a circle placement into a canonical id and a `Spell`; `resolveSpell` resolves those ids, so combat, empower and the strip keep working unchanged. The server action `POST /api/circle` validates the placement against unlocked tier / runes / element thresholds, rolls form, failure and rare outcomes, charges elements and records the result. The client gets a parchment component (replacing `SynthesisAltar`) and a star-map grimoire (replacing the tree in `GrimoirePanel`).

**Tech Stack:** TypeScript, Vitest, zod, Hono (Cloudflare Worker, D1), React, Pixi (unchanged).

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-30-magic-circle-design.md` (parent: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-29-magic-research-rework-design.md`). Work on a new branch `feat/magic-circle` from `main`.

## Global Constraints

- Scope (user, spec "範圍"): systems and core features first; **content minimal** (the spec 2.5 examples + a few textbook spells per element and tier band so every route can progress); **numbers are placeholders** — only the rules the tests gate must hold. Do not re-balance zones.
- Tier = node count with the core counted as 1: Lv.1 core only; Lv.2–6 ring 1 holds 1–5 nodes (5 = pentagram); Lv.7–10 ring 2 holds 1–4 nodes. Core grade caps the tier: 初階 2, 中階 4, 高階 6, 極階 8, 神階 10. Slots beyond the cap or beyond the unlocked tier cannot be placed.
- Ring element floor: ring 1 ≥ 初階, ring 2 ≥ 高階. A higher grade in a ring gives no bonus; ids ignore node grades.
- Unlocked tier (spec 2.6 option B): start 2; using the key item of mist_meadow → 4, thunder_gorge → 6, ember_wastes → 8, sunken_temple → 9, starfall_plateau → 10; worlds_end adds nothing.
- Runes (spec 2.7), unlocked by defeated bosses: start 射(bolt); mist 刃(blades) 波(ring); gorge 鏈(chain) 域(zone); ember 墜(meteor); temple 嵐(storm); plateau 臨(field); worlds_end none. Runes cost nothing.
- One rune per ring. Different runes across rings: the server picks one form uniformly among the distinct runes. Core-only circle: form bolt.
- Pentagram (ring 1, positions 0..4): circle neighbours (i, i+1) are 相生 pairs, star lines (i, i+2) 相剋 pairs. 相剋: 水剋火, 火剋風, 風剋土, 土剋雷, 雷剋水. 相生 cycle: 水 → 土 → 火 → 雷 → 風 → 水.
- Circuit (spec 3.4 as revised): the core counts as the inner layer; layers core↔ring 1 and ring 1↔ring 2 match when Σ outward branches of the inner layer = Σ inward branches of the outer layer and no connected pair is 相剋 (core ↔ every ring-1 node; ring-1 slot j ↔ ring-2 slot j).
- Outcomes this project: normal success or big failure only. Big failure: elements spent, nothing learned. Base 10% (placeholder), raised per mismatched layer. Rare: specific Lv.10 circles, 2% → the rare named spell (discoveries + full-screen reveal reused).
- Same spell = canonical circle: core element, actual tier, node element kinds per ring with rotation/mirror of the pentagram folded (one canonical string), the resulting form; every ring's rune normalised to the form.
- Named spells = generated spell + name/desc/hint/chant/school; multi-form named spells are compressed to their main form. Spell elements = every element on the circle.
- Empower unchanged (+1–10 初階, +11–20 中階…, +50, `EMPOWER_MAX` 1.4).
- Server is the bank: learned spells, unlocked tier and synthesis log are server-owned; `audit.ts` rejects uploads that change them. `tests/sim` routes 0 rejections and worker adversarial tests stay green.
- Saves reset with a new migration `0008_magic_circle.sql`.
- UI copy Traditional Chinese; colours per AGENTS.md; React narrow selectors (no whole-`game` subscriptions in the parchment or star map).
- Commits: Conventional Commits in English ending with
  `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>` and
  `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01BbLnQR1oxFiq58K5QZz56M`.

## Review Focus

1. A placement the UI should never send (slot beyond unlocked tier or core cap, ring-2 node below 高階, a locked rune, a missing element) must be a 422 refusal that writes nothing and is not counted as cheating — Task 3 tests `refuses …` cases.
2. Two circles that differ only by rotation or mirror must give the same id and spell; two that differ in a 相生/相剋 relation must not — Task 1 test `canonical id folds rotation and mirror only`.
3. A save containing a crafted id `c(…)` or a removed recipe spell (old format) must not crash `resolveSpell`/`parseState`; saves are reset, but a stale client upload must still be a clean 400/422 — Task 3 test `old-format learned ids are rejected cleanly`.
4. A big failure must still charge elements into the anti-cheat anchor so a later upload is not rejected — Task 3 worker test `failed circle charges the anchor`.
5. The parchment must keep the placement when the server refuses or the request fails (no lost work) — Task 5 test `keeps the circle on refusal`.

### Task 1: Circle rules (pure engine)

**Files:**
- Create: `src/engine/circle.ts`, `src/engine/circle.test.ts`, `src/data/content/circle-rules.json`
- Modify: `src/engine/content.ts` (load and validate `circle-rules.json`), `src/engine/model.ts` (types)

**Interfaces:**
- Produces (exact names; later tasks use them):
  - `type RuneId = 'bolt' | 'blades' | 'ring' | 'chain' | 'zone' | 'meteor' | 'storm' | 'field'` with display names 射 刃 波 鏈 域 墜 嵐 臨 (`RUNE_NAMES`).
  - `interface CircleNode { element: ElementId; grade: number }`
  - `interface Placement { core: CircleNode; ring1: (CircleNode | null)[] /* length 5, pentagram positions */; ring2: (CircleNode | null)[] /* length 5, slot j sits outside ring-1 slot j; at most 4 filled */; runes: [RuneId | null, RuneId | null] }`
  - `const GRADE_CAP = [2, 4, 6, 8, 10]` (by core grade 1..5); `const RING_FLOOR = [1, 3]` (ring 1 ≥ 初階, ring 2 ≥ 高階).
  - `placementTier(p: Placement): number` — 1 + filled nodes.
  - `placementProblems(p: Placement, ctx: { unlockedTier: number; runes: RuneId[] }): CircleProblem[]` — `CircleProblem = 'overCap' | 'overUnlocked' | 'ring2BeforeRing1Full' | 'tooManyRing2' | 'belowRingFloor' | 'runeLocked' | 'runeWithoutRing' | 'ringWithoutRune'`.
  - `branches(p: Placement): { core: { out: number }; ring1: ({ in: number; out: number } | null)[]; ring2: ({ in: number } | null)[] }` — from `circle-rules.json`.
  - `circuitMismatches(p: Placement): number` — 0, 1 or 2 mismatched layers.
  - `relations(p: Placement): { generate: [ElementId, ElementId][]; overcome: [ElementId, ElementId][] }` — ring-1 neighbour and star pairs present.
  - `possibleForms(p: Placement): RuneId[]` — distinct runes of the used rings; `['bolt']` for a core-only circle.
  - `canonicalCircle(p: Placement, form: RuneId): string` — `m:` id, e.g. `m:fire.5.ff.w.ff..|.....|bolt`-style; exact format is the implementer's, but it must fold the 10 rotations/mirrors of the 5 positions (applied to ring 1 and ring 2 together) by taking the lexicographically smallest, ignore node grades, use the actual tier (`min(placementTier, GRADE_CAP[core.grade-1])`).
  - `parseCanonical(id: string): { core: ElementId; tier: number; ring1: (ElementId|null)[]; ring2: (ElementId|null)[]; form: RuneId } | null` — never throws.
  - `runesUnlocked(defeatedBosses: string[], content: Content): RuneId[]` and `tierUnlockOf(keyItemId: ItemId): number | null` (map from Global Constraints; the data lives in `circle-rules.json`).

`circle-rules.json` holds: per element default `{ coreOut, in, out }` branch counts plus per-ring / per-position adjustments (personality: 雷 tends to branch outward, 土 single-line), the rune unlock table by boss id, the key-item → tier table. Branch numbers are placeholders but the rule must make every textbook circle of Task 2 match (Task 2 adds that test).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write failing tests in `src/engine/circle.test.ts`:**
  - `tier counts the core`: core only → 1; core + 3 ring-1 → 4; core + 5 + 2 → 8.
  - `placement problems`: 初階 core with 2 ring-1 nodes → `overCap`; unlockedTier 4 with 4 ring-1 nodes → `overUnlocked`; ring-2 node while ring 1 has 4 → `ring2BeforeRing1Full`; ring-2 node 中階 → `belowRingFloor`; rune 鏈 without the gorge boss → `runeLocked`; ring 1 used and `runes[0]` null → `ringWithoutRune`; a valid Lv.2 fire bolt → `[]`.
  - `pentagram relations`: ring 1 [水, 土, 火, 雷, 風] → 5 generate pairs, 0 overcome; [水, 火, …] adjacency 水–火 is not a generate pair and positions (0,2) 水/火 is an overcome pair.
  - `canonical id folds rotation and mirror only`: rotating ring 1 (and ring 2 with it) by 1–4 positions and mirroring give the same id; swapping two non-equivalent elements (changing a 相剋 star pair into a neighbour pair) gives a different id; changing a node from 中階 to 高階 keeps the id; core grade beyond need keeps the id.
  - `parseCanonical round-trips` and returns null for `''`, `c(a|b)`, `m:` garbage.
  - `forms`: rings with 射 and 墜(meteor) → `['bolt','meteor']`; same rune twice → one; core only → `['bolt']`.
  - `runes unlock by bosses` and `tierUnlockOf` per the table.

### Task 2: Spells generated from circles

**Files:**
- Create: `src/engine/circle-spell.ts`, `src/engine/circle-spell.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/engine/spells.ts` (`resolveSpell` resolves `m:` ids; crafted `c(…)` resolution removed), `src/engine/model.ts` (`NamedSpellDef` gains `circle?: string`, the canonical id it names; `node`, `prerequisites`, `baseOf` become optional/removed as Task 6 needs), `src/data/content/spells.json` (textbook circles), `src/engine/content.ts`, `tests/sim/measure.ts` + `tests/sim/tier-curve.test.ts` (measure generated circles), `scripts/measure-dps.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 1 (`parseCanonical`, `relations`, `RuneId`).
- Produces:
  - `circleSpell(id: string, content: Content): Spell | null` — deterministic; `tier` from the id; `elements` = every distinct element on the circle (core first); `effects` = one effect of the form's `Effect['kind']` (rune → kind table in Global Constraints) whose `mult`/radius/count scale with tier and node counts, plus statuses from node elements (火 burn, 風 push/擊退, 水 wet, 土 slow, 雷 extra chain/hops) — more nodes of one element = stronger; 相生 pairs add a bonus, 相剋 pairs weaken or add a reaction (small table in `circle-rules.json`, placeholders); `attack` follows `TIER_STEP` per tier.
  - A named spell def with `circle` set overlays name/nameEn/desc/hint/chant/school on `circleSpell(circle)`; `namedFor(circleId, content): NamedSpellDef | undefined`.
  - Rare named spells keep their own ids and data (compressed to one effect) and gain `circle` = their Lv.10 circle (Task 3 rolls them).
  - `resolveSpell(id)`: named id → named data (rare + `mana_bolt` + `mana_overload`); `m:` id → `circleSpell` with the overlay; anything else → null.

Content (minimal, spec "範圍"): give `circle` to the spec 2.5 examples (火球, 煉獄, 疾風刃, 斷空風鐮, 落雷, 萬雷, 岩槍, 黑曜荊棘, 湧泉之環, 大漩渦, 隕石) re-laid to meet the ring floor and core caps, plus enough per element so that each tier band 2/4/6/8/10 has at least one textbook circle per element. Named spells without a circle stay in data but are not learnable (they are not shown anywhere; Task 6). Multi-form ones that get a circle use their main form.

  - `deterministic`: same id twice → deep-equal spells.
  - `elements are every element on the circle`: 煉獄's circle (火 火 風 火) → `['fire','wind']`.
  - `named overlay`: the 火球 circle resolves with name 火球 and generated effects.
  - `every textbook circle matches its circuit` (Task 1 `circuitMismatches` = 0) and `every textbook circle respects caps and floors`.
  - `rotation of a textbook circle is the same spell`.

### Task 3: Server synthesis, unlocks, save format

**Files:**
- Create: `src/engine/circle-synth.ts`, `src/engine/circle-synth.test.ts`, `migrations/0008_magic_circle.sql`
- Modify: `src/engine/model.ts` + `src/engine/persist.ts` (`revealed` replaced by `circleTier: number`, default 2; `synthesisLog` keyed by canonical id), `src/engine/audit.ts` (`circleTier changed` rejection; learned may only hold resolvable ids), `src/engine/tree.ts` (key item use → `circleTier`; `revealRegion`/`visibleRegions` removed; `depthCap` removed), `src/engine/crafting.ts` and `src/data/content/recipes.json` (removed), `worker/app.ts` (`POST /api/circle` replaces `/api/synthesize`; `/api/reveal` becomes `POST /api/key-item`), `src/game/api.ts`, `src/game/sync.ts` (action kinds), `worker/app.test.ts`, `tests/d1/*` (migration test), `src/ui/gm/*` (recipes tab lists textbook circles instead of recipes; keep it minimal)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Tasks 1–2.
- Produces:
  - `synthesizeCircle(state: GameState, p: Placement, content: Content, rng: Rng): { state: GameState; result: CircleResult }`
  - `type CircleResult = { kind: 'learned' | 'known'; spellId: string; form: RuneId; rare?: boolean } | { kind: 'failed'; form: RuneId } | { kind: 'rejected'; reason: CircleProblem | 'insufficient' }` — `known` = already learned (elements still spent; no duplicate entry).
  - Cost: one element item per placed node and the core, at the grade placed (`elementItem(e, grade)`); removed on success and on failure.
  - Roll order (one rng stream): form uniformly among `possibleForms`; failure with chance `FAIL_BASE` 0.10 + `FAIL_PER_MISMATCH` 0.25 × `circuitMismatches` (placeholders, exported constants); if not failed and the canonical id (with the rolled form) equals a rare spell's `circle`, `RARE_CHANCE` 0.02 → learn the rare spell id instead.
  - `useKeyItem(state, keyItemId, content)` → `circleTier = max(circleTier, tierUnlockOf(id))`, consumes the key item; rejects unknown / not held / no effect.
  - `POST /api/circle` body `{ baseRevision, state, placement }` (zod-validated shape; 400 on malformed), through `serverAction`; rare → `recordDiscovery` exactly as `/api/synthesize` did; `store.recordSynthesis(playerId, t, canonicalCircle, resultKey)`.
- [ ] **Step 1: Write failing tests** (`circle-synth.test.ts` and `worker/app.test.ts`):
  - `learns a Lv.2 fire bolt and spends 初階火 ×2`; `known on repeat spends again, one entry`.
  - `refuses …` for every `CircleProblem` and for missing elements: 422 via the worker, nothing written, `store.rejections` empty.
  - `mixed runes pick each form about half the time` (seeded rng over 400 rolls, each within 40–60%).
  - `mismatched circuit fails more often` (rate with 1 mismatch > rate with 0).
  - `failed circle charges the anchor`: a failed `/api/circle` then a PUT of the returned state 60 s later is accepted.
  - `rare circle rolls the rare spell at RARE_CHANCE` (inject rng) and writes `discoveries`.
  - `key item raises circleTier and is consumed`; `circleTier cannot be changed by an upload`.
  - `old-format learned ids are rejected cleanly`: an upload whose `learned` has `c(fireball|rock_spear)` → 400 `invalid state`.
  - D1 migration test: 0008 applies and resets saves.
- [ ] **Step 2: Run to see them fail**, implement, then `npm test` (route sims still skipped from Task 2) and `npm run build`.
- [ ] **Step 3: Commit** — `feat: server magic circle synthesis, key items open circle tiers, save reset`.

### Task 5: Parchment (magic circle UI)

**Files:**
- Create: `src/ui/CircleTable.tsx`, `src/ui/CircleTable.test.tsx`, `src/ui/circle-draw.ts` (SVG geometry of core/rings/pentagram/slots, pure, tested)
- Modify: `src/ui/App.tsx` (replace `SynthesisAltar`), `src/ui/App.css`, `src/game/sync.ts` (`synthesizeCircle(placement)` action), remove `SynthesisAltar.tsx`, `altar-data.ts`, `last-combo.ts` and their tests

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 1 helpers (`placementProblems`, `branches`, `circuitMismatches`, `relations`, `placementTier`), Task 3 action.
- Produces: `CircleTable({ runtime, sync, content })`; `loadPlacement(p: Placement)` hook/prop so Task 6 can put a learned spell's circle on the parchment.

Behaviour (spec 2.1, 3.5, 3.8):
- Worn parchment with an empty circle; clicking the core / a ring-1 / ring-2 slot opens a small picker of held elements (grade shown) — and for a ring, its rune picker. Each placement animates as being drawn (CSS stroke-dashoffset), disabled slots (locked tier, over core cap) shown greyed with the reason.
- Each placed node shows its inward/outward branch counts; a mismatched layer is marked.
- Prediction line: main element, additional effects, `約 Lv.N`, warnings (`迴路對不上：大失敗機率提高`); **no form**.
- 合成: button disabled with the reason while `placementProblems` is non-empty or elements are short. On press: circular progress ring for **3 s** (5 s when the result is rare) with element-coloured sparks, then the result (learned / known / failed text). Refusal or network failure: no animation, the circle stays, reason shown.
- Tap/click only (no drag) and usable at 390 px width.
